testcase.name: Scenario: Select a face while a panel expansion is pinned: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:496:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a face while a panel expansion is pinned ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and pinned ✔ When the user clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area ✔ Then the clicked face is selected ✔ And the Modify additional command area remains open ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user unpins the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the face selection is cleared ✔ And the Modify additional command area closes
